A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same IPVRM/DistRL research and contain 16 complete pages, including Appendices A–G. Their text, equations, tables, and figures support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original reward-model evaluations, downstream policy experiments, ablations, and computational measurements in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including Best-of-N selection, ProcessBench verification, policy accuracy, and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: Both retain prefixwise margin BCE, cumulative log-ratio scoring, DistRL’s two optimization branches, and ADB/DLW online updates. The clarified post-token indexing in v3 matches the cumulative parameterization already given in Equation (5); no distinct algorithmic procedure is introduced.

E1.justification: The Eurus-2 training corpora and evaluation coverage remain unchanged: MATH-500, Minerva-Math, AMC/AMC-23, AIME, OlympiadBench, and ProcessBench, including its format-shift setting.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain Q-RM, EndoRM, DPO-RM, and Implicit PRM for reward modeling, and the same GRPO, PRIME, SPRO, and Reinforce with Q-RM policy baselines. Comparator membership in the supplementary comparisons also matches.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix C retain the models, data filtering, sampling settings, training budgets, and metrics. Both ProcessBench scoring protocols remain in Appendix G. The newly discussed unfiltered, zero-margin setting is an interpretive assumption, not a newly reported experiment.

E4.justification: Both contain the same temporal-weighting, reward-model/optimizer, TD-signal, online-balancing, reference-choice, hyperparameter-sensitivity, and scoring-protocol analyses. Their questions and empirical evidence are retained.

E5.justification: Appendix C retains the dataloader seed of 42 and the same statement about other seeds. Table 13 retains its timing uncertainty reporting; no repeated-run, confidence-interval, or significance-testing practice changes.

E6.justification: Tables 1–14 and the plotted findings retain their results. For example, Qwen3-0.6B IPVRM still reports 28.1 average Best-of-N accuracy in Table 1, 39.1 ProcessBench F1 in Table 2, and 16.7 DistRL AVG@8 in Table 5.

T1.justification: v3 explicitly defines behavior-policy continuation success as a conditional expectation in Equation (9), states conditions for its probability interpretation, and corrects the normalized prefix expression to V(st+1)/t. The appendix derivations remain unchanged apart from numbering and cross-references; no new proof is supplied.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction retain the same IPVRM/DistRL contributions and empirical claims. The rewritten conclusion emphasizes improved reranking, which was already claimed earlier in v2, and retains the broader eventual-correctness probability claim.

C2.justification: Sections 3–3.2 substantially qualify the meaning of the central reward signal. v2 presents the sigmoid output as an eventual-success probability; v3 restricts that interpretation to idealized unfiltered, zero-margin training and describes the actual balanced-margin output as discriminative. It explains continuation-policy dependence and explicitly distinguishes additive potential differences from probability differences. The existing Section 4.3.3 caveat about TD not estimating long-horizon return is retained.

D1.justification: Appendix C retains the same implementation, hyperparameter, LoRA, normalization, and software details. Code and data access information and computational measurements are unchanged.

R1.justification: The reference list and Appendix A are unchanged. The work retains its positioning around low-cost implicit rewards and the train–inference mismatch of sequence-level supervision.

P1.justification: Section 3.1 is expanded and reorganized under two explanatory subheadings, with localized edits to the methodology overview, candidate-token discussion, and conclusion. A funding acknowledgement replaces the AI-use disclosure. The broader document organization remains stable.

P2.justification: The expanded methodology introduces additional numbered equation displays and shifts several existing figures and tables between columns or pages, including Figures 4–5. Figure designs, table structures, captions, and appendix layout are otherwise retained.

improvement.justification: v3 improves technical clarity by distinguishing discriminative prefix scores from calibrated probabilities, separating local shaping from probability changes, and resolving prefix indexing. These useful corrections retain the empirical evidence. However, broader probability language remains in the abstract, introduction, conclusion, and Appendix F, so the conceptual clarification is incomplete.
